scope: Record only reign-persistent progression directly supported by the September 28 Hatchery reward screens. Relic awards are persistent. Star-rank changes are recorded only when directly supported by a Star Up label or an unambiguous post-reward state; no habit level is inferred from Hatchery results.
verification_notes: IMG_5245.jpeg through IMG_5248.jpeg are overlapping views of one Hatchery reward result; repeated cards across the screenshots are counted once.
The reward result contains 70 visible relics across 15 already-owned dragons.
No 'Star Up!' or 'Hatched!' label is visible, so no star-rank or ownership change is recorded from this batch.
Relic quantities are retained as reign-persistent increments, but exact post-batch relic counters are not reconstructed from progress-bar proportions alone.
No habit unlock or habit-level change is inferred from the reward screen.
The visible star rows are treated only as consistency checks against the September 27 overlay; this file does not supersede previously verified star ranks without an explicit progression event.
Gold, keys, and the next-open price shown on the reward screen are kept only in the dated Hatchery log, not this persistent progression overlay.
